whisper.label: Whisper Large-V3
whisper.text:
Diffraction gratings are a mature optical technology distinguished as much by manufacturing innovations as applications, and as much by operating theory as design approaches.
To adequately spotlight the technology is to provide a comprehensive overview of the complete gratings value chain.
Omega Optical is a leading developer and manufacturer of optical gratings, mastering the necessary steps in component, design, replication, and marketing.
The company's award-winning deep UV transmission gratings underscore pioneering advances in manufacturing technology and application awareness, supporting some of industry's most high-value applications.
In this spotlight conversation with David Ventola, Omega Optical's Director of Engineering for Diffractive Optics,
All Things Photonics delivers precisely that which is needed to spotlight gratings technology, a comprehensive overview of the complete value chain.
Ventola is a leading authority on the science, application, and technology of optical gratings.
He is a leading authority on the science, application, and utilization of diffraction technologies.
In our interview, he scrutinizes gratings through a lens that indicates grating innovation is not only ongoing, but that it is driven by industry.
It is another distinction for the technology.
It is the designers and manufacturers, not the R&D sector, that is pioneering this industry-critical component.
Today's episode is brought to you by Hamamatsu Corporation,
a leading manufacturer of devices for the generation.
The company is responsible for the production and measurement of infrared, visible, UV light, and X-rays.
Hamamatsu is dedicated to the advancement of photonics through extensive research,
and offers specialized systems for select applications.
Visit hamamatsu.com to learn more.
And by Omega Optical.
From filters and coatings to gratings in infrared materials and assemblies,
Omega Optical designs and manufactures critical optical elements,
guiding light between sources,
and sensors.
Omega Optical delivers products and solutions covering deep ultraviolet to far infrared.
Visit omega-optical.com to learn more.
